thm:direct-sum-firewall.note: Proved: any PSD blocks assemble to a PSD direct sum (including a singular or zero second block), the compression to the first summand equals T1 exactly, and it is independent of the second block - so a coercive statement about one typed block constrains nothing about the other without an intertwining theorem.

thm:marginals.title: Exact difference and sum selectors
thm:marginals.note: Proved for windowed finite port polynomials with arbitrary coefficients (the weights w_X(m) m^{-sigma} of the display are absorbed into the coefficient sequences): the phase integral over [0,1] is the exact Kronecker selector, the normal (difference) marginal picks out m - n = h, and the anomalous (sum) marginal picks out m + n = N.

cor:twin-gold-port.title: Twin and Goldbach ports
cor:twin-gold-port.note: Proved: for the von Mangoldt coefficients and unit window the h = 2 difference block collapses to the twin correlation sum_{n <= X-2} Lambda(n+2) Lambda(n), and for N < X the N-sum block is the full Goldbach correlation sum_{m+n=N} Lambda(m) Lambda(n) - two typed projections of one tensor.

thm:car-prime.note: NCG/Arithmetic/ArithParity.lean: the signed permutation sum vanishes for k >= 2 (pairing by a fixed transposition), so the CAR endpoint on the symmetric ordered-history source returns the target at depth one and annihilates every deeper symmetric history (car_prime_endpoint, linear-map form). thm:parity-recovery.title: Exact depth-one recovery

thm:twin-chain.title: Conditional twin-prime chain

thm:gold-chain.title: Conditional binary Goldbach chain

L^j) is proved for every j and every n (squarefree core via the divisors <-> powerset bridge and rescale-exp product law; nonsquarefree targets vanish under mu^2). Low-degree vanishing (X^omega divisibility), coefficient nonnegativity, and the exact values at primes and semiprimes are included. Standard axioms only.

lem:v003-selberg.title: Selberg degree-two identity
lem:v003-selberg.note: NCG/Arithmetic/SelbergIdentity.lean: the FULL Selberg degree-two identity Lambda_2(n) = Lambda(n) log n + (Lambda*Lambda)(n) for every n >= 1, proved combinatorially via the log-derivation on the Dirichlet ring (L(f*g) = Lf*g + f*Lg applied to Lambda*zeta = log, then Moebius inversion), replacing the manuscript Dirichlet-series argument. Includes the bridge Lambda_1 = vonMangoldt to the Mathlib arithmetic-function framework. Standard axioms only.

cor:v003-atom-bulk.title: Exact prime atom plus semiprime bulk
cor:v003-atom-bulk.note: NCG/Arithmetic/SignedSeparator.lean: the exact split P_{<=2}(n) = mu^2 Lambda/L (1 + log n/(2L)) + mu^2/(2L^2) (Lambda_1*Lambda_1)(n) for every n >= 2, with the convolution supported exactly on squarefree semiprimes (value 2 log r log q) and the first term on primes. Standard axioms only.

thm:v003-signed-separator.title: Exact cancellation of the squarefree $P_2$ layer
thm:v003-signed-separator.note: NCG/Arithmetic/SignedSeparator.lean: J = (6/7)(B_1 + B_2 - (2/alpha)B_3) equals (6/7)alpha + (1/7)alpha^2 at a prime, vanishes exactly at squarefree semiprimes (the P_2 layer cancellation, via Lambda_3(pq) = 3ab(a+b)), and satisfies the boxed pointwise minorant J(n) <= 1_P(n) for 2 <= n and log n <= L. At depth >= 3 the Lean statement gives J <= 0 from B_3 >= 0 (coefficient nonnegativity); the strict negativity display -12/(7 alpha) B_3 < 0 at depth exactly three is not separately certified. Standard axioms only.

cor:v003-signed-additive-closure.title: Signed fixed-gap and fixed-sum closure
cor:v003-signed-additive-closure.note: NCG/Arithmetic/SignedSeparator.lean: positivity of a nonnegatively log-weighted sum of minorant values forces a prime target; instantiated for the fixed-gap (p, p+2) and fixed-sum (p, N-p) correlations. The analytic positivity of the correlations themselves is the declared open input (Type-II/parity estimate). Standard axioms only.

thm:v003-cauchy-minorant.title: Stable Cauchy minorant
thm:v003-cauchy-minorant.note: Proved with the entire packet E_{z,X} realized as its absolutely convergent Taylor series sum_j B_j z^j (factorial decay of the Mellin coefficients from |Lambda_j(n)| <= tau(n) (log n)^j; the product display is the formal identity NCG.mellin_degree, as in the thm:v003-mellin-degree record): bank_alias is the exact root-of-unity aliasing D^(j) = sum_{d = j mod m} B_d r^d/r^j (geometric root sums + Complex.exp_eq_one_iff), cauchy_minorant is the stable sandwich 0 <= P_{<=2} - c <= theta C_s E_s by coefficientwise domination 0 <= 1_{d in {1,2}} - kappa_d <= theta C_s s^d against the nonnegative coefficients (the residue-class tail estimate r^{d-j} = theta^l s^{d-j} <= theta C_s s^d), and bank_weight gives the m-independent coefficient weight r^{-j} per bank, hence the display total r^{-1} + r^{-2} + theta C_s.

corollary:dyadic-bank.title: Dyadic bank
corollary:dyadic-bank.note: Proved: at r = 1/4, s = 1/2 the aliasing constant evaluates to theta C_s = 6/2^m and the total coefficient variation r^-1 + r^-2 + theta C_s <= 26; the transfer sandwich is instantiated at these constants. The pointwise dyadic sandwich itself enters as the hypothesis inherited from thm:v003-cauchy-minorant, which remains open.

thm:v003-cauchy-transfer.title: Positive-mass transfer through the finite bank
thm:v003-cauchy-transfer.note: Proved exactly as in the manuscript: multiplying the pointwise minorant sandwich 0 <= P(n) - c(n) <= K E(n) by nonnegative weights and summing gives Q - K U <= C <= Q. The pointwise sandwich enters as the hypothesis, supplied by the Cauchy-minorant theorem (thm:v003-cauchy-minorant).
